reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|IsActive|DialectBehavior' in FixedFileAttributes.cs, KeyedConnector.FixedAttributeConflict and MetaPage: none; the GR8 comparison and the meta page written at creation are edition-free
reader.requirement: At --std 85 an indexed file's minimum and maximum record sizes are fixed when the file is created (OPEN OUTPUT or optional creation) and are not changed by a later OPEN through a description of other sizes; such an OPEN is refused with the file attribute conflict '39' (GR8, the implementor's validated set per DOC-A.1-129), the file unaffected, while a new OPEN OUTPUT re-creates the file with the new sizes.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf25_03 covers fixed-length records (RECORD CONTAINS 20 against 30); variable-length minimum and maximum (RECORD IS VARYING with OCCURS DEPENDING ON) are not exercised

probes.printed: CREATE 00; WRITES 00; MAX30 39; MIN6 39; SAME 00; READ 00 07 03; RECREATE 00; OLD-DESC 39; NEW-DESC 00
probes.expected: created VARYING 4 TO 20: a description 4 TO 30 or 6 TO 20 conflicts (39); the same description opens and reads the 7-character record; OPEN OUTPUT through 4 TO 30 re-creates, after which the old description conflicts

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR18  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR18
OK  §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR8  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8

reader.notes: The keyed store's meta page records the minimum and maximum record size at creation; FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered asks KeyedConnector.FixedAttributeConflict (MetaPage plus FixedFileAttributes.Conflicts) before OpenCore for every non-OUTPUT mode on a present file, so a description of other sizes is 39 and the file is untouched; OUTPUT is a creation and establishes new sizes.

refuter.evidence: Probe r18.cob (class c/a, the 1985 RECORD CONTAINS 4 TO 20 form, which the reader did not try): created 00, wrote 4- and 20-character records; reopened through RECORD IS VARYING 4 TO 20: 00 and READ gave length 04; through RECORD CONTAINS 20 (fixed): 39; through no RECORD clause with 01s of 4 and 20: 39; through the creating description: 00. The no-RECORD-clause 39 is within latitude: the record type (fixed or variable) is a fixed file attribute (§1985 definitions), which attributes are validated is the implementor's (GR8), format 3 fixed-or-variable is implementor defined (VII.3.8.4 GR13), and docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-129.md documents that the keyed meta page validates record type and minimum/maximum size. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR18 'established at the time the file is created'; OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR8 'The implementor defines which of the fixed file attributes are validated'; OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR13 'implementor defined whether format 3 of the RECORD clause produces fixed length records'; OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR1 'the size of each data record is completely defined'.
